items.title: State Senate: Republicans keep a bare majority
items.text: Republicans lead or are unopposed in 29 of 56 seats, the minimum for a majority. Their closest lead is 1,661 votes, 2.0 pts.

items.title: State House: Democrats gain a majority
items.text: Democrats lead or are unopposed in 92 of 180 seats, 1 more than the 91 needed for a majority. Their closest lead is 35 votes, 0.1 pts.
